requested_changes.title: The actual new host leaf is not checked before mkdir/private ACL work
requested_changes.evidence: Host.New passes only filepath.Dir(cfg.Dir) into ValidateTrialVaultIsolation and checks filepath.Base(cfg.Dir)=='host'. The helper checks dataRoot and oldHostDir/parent, not cfg.Dir. With canonical disjoint data roots and a preexisting new dataRoot/host junction to the old Host directory, the guard can pass and os.MkdirAll/privateDir(cfg.Dir) at135-138 follows the child alias and touches the old protected Host. Moving the parent guard before lease/Open fixed the original ordering, but does not close the descendant alias.

Allow the legitimate absent new host leaf under a verified ordinary parent; if present it must be an ordinary canonical directory with disjoint identity. Apply equivalent checks to the Control DB/host paths before mutable initialization so root isolation cannot be defeated by an existing child. Preserve the early partial-tuple rejection and original nontrial path. Verify actual Windows behavior separately; do not claim EvalSymlinks/SameFile name checks alone reject every future reparse tag.
